_comment: Pinned server manifest for the puppet-mcp launcher. npm IS the release: the built runtime zip ships inside this tarball under bin/ (no GitHub Release page exists). On first run the launcher provisions from that bundled zip, verifying its sha256 and size before extraction and the extracted server after; versions published before the tarball carried a zip fall back to the tagged Release URL in runtime.source, verified the same way. The release workflow fills the runtime.* hashes it computes from the real build artifacts; the committed manifest carries placeholders the launcher refuses to run with.
